sloka: रामो ऽपि सह सैन्येन समुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः ।हर्षं लेभे रिपुं हत्वा यथा वृत्रं शतक्रतुः ।। ६.११४.११६ ।।
transliteration: rāmo 'pi saha sainyena samugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ।harṣaṁ lebhe ripuṁ hatvā yathā vṛtraṁ śatakratuḥ ।। 6.114.116 ।।

translations.english: Then proceeding in sequence constructing an altar in the southeast and placing sacrificial fire in a proper place, they duly performed in honour of the ruler of Rakshasas.
